basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad has invited applications for 1 Project Assistant post in a 12-month sponsored project under TEXMiN, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, on reducing coal dust in an open-cast mine. The fellowship is ₹24,000/- (including HRA), and the essential qualification is a B.Sc./ 3-year Diploma in Engineering and Technology. Candidates must email their updated CV and supporting documents to [email protected] by 10 November 2026, 05:00 pm.

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed to shortlisted candidates

how_to_apply: Applications for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant post are made by email only. Send the application, with your updated CV and supporting documents, to [email protected] by 10 November 2026, 05:00 pm. This is the email address of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sarthak S. Singh.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Mitigating coal dust in an open-cast mine with biodegradable binder using an unmanned aerial spray system

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age limit: The upper age limit for the Project Assistant post is 50 years. Upper age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Women applicants will be applicable as per GoI rules. Experience in drone operations and coal handling is listed as desirable, not essential. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post. content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: As printed in the notice, the Project Assistant will be responsible for the following: Carrying out binder spray activities over the coal in the lab to optimize the binder concentration Operate the unmanned aerial spray system in the open cast mines and record the relevant environmental parameters.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant post are made by email only. Send the application, with your updated CV and supporting documents, to [email protected] by 10 November 2026, 05:00 pm. This is the email address of the Principal Investigator, Prof. Sarthak S. Singh. Documents named in the notice: Application Updated CV Supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant post will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirement of the project. Meeting the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Shortlisted candidates will be told the date of the interview. All candidates should make their own arrangements for their stay at Dhanbad, if required. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) Project Assistant position under the sponsored project (IIT (ISM) Project No. SRDP 1411G).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date is 10 November 2026, until 05:00 pm, for emailing the application with an updated CV and supporting documents.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a B.Sc./ 3-year Diploma in Engineering and Technology. Experience in drone operations and experience in coal handling are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years. Upper age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Women applicants will be applicable as per GoI rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹24,000/- (Including HRA).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹24,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the fellowship of ₹24,000/- already includes HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Email the application, your updated CV and supporting documents to [email protected] by 10 November 2026, 05:00 pm.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and as per the requirement of the project, and shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date. Meeting the minimum qualification does not guarantee an interview call.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview, and candidates should make their own arrangements for their stay at Dhanbad, if required.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the tenure of the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad project?
faq.answer: The tenure of the project is 12 months.
